ideas.topic: The Hidden Message in King Tut’s Dagger
ideas.hook: This dagger wasn't forged on Earth—it was literally a gift from the stars.
ideas.why: It leverages the high interest in Tutankhamun and metallurgy by focusing on the 'space iron' phenomenon, which historically drives high engagement.

ideas.topic: Why Ancient Egyptians Painted Skin Colors Differently
ideas.hook: Why are men in Egyptian paintings almost always painted darker than the women?
ideas.why: It addresses cultural curiosity and visual analysis of ancient art, mirroring the successful 'dogs in paintings' format while maintaining a calm, educational tone.

ideas.topic: The Mystery of the Unfinished Obelisk
ideas.hook: This massive 1,000-ton stone monument was abandoned mid-construction, and we still don't know why.
ideas.why: It uses the 'mystery' and 'impossible problem' framing found in the top-performing pyramid videos, appealing to viewers fascinated by ancient engineering secrets.
